Project's HDFS UDF path

Task instance batch number of the instance generated
Task code of the task which refers to this variable
Instance code of the task instance which refers to this variable

Business time of the task instance.Business time is defined as the starting time of the task's frequency cycle.    If now is 3 June 2021, 09:30AM    For daily task the business time is 0AM of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-06-03 00:00:00    For weekly task the business time is the Monday 0AM of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-05-31 00:00:00    For monthly task, the business time is 0AM of 1st day of the month of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-06-01 00:00:00    For hourly task, the business time is the hourly start of the task instance generation time, e.g. 2021-06-03 09:00:00
Date of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMMdd, e.g. 20210603
Previous month of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMM, e.g. 202105
Previous date of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMMdd, e.g. 20210531
Previous hour of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMMddhh, e.g. 2021053109
Year of the current task instance business time, format yyyy, e.g. 2020
Month of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMM, e.g. 202005
Date of the current task instance business time, format dd, e.g. 30
Hour of the current task instance business time , format hh, eg: 18

The time of a day a scheduled task instance is supposed to be launched. If now is 3 June 2021, 09:30AM. For daily, weekly and monthly task, the scheduled time is 0AM of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-06-03 00:00:00 For hourly task, the schedule time is the hourly start of the task instance generation time, e.g. 2021-06-03 09:00:00
The date of a scheduled task instance is supposed to be launched, format yyyyMMdd. The date of a scheduled task instance is supposed to be launched, format yyyyMMdd.
The previous date of a scheduled task instance is supposed to be launched, format yyyyMMdd.

The time of a task instance starts running after all input dependencies are met. If the start run time is 3 June 2021, 09:30AM. For daily, weekly and monthly task, the start run time is 0AM of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-06-03 00:00:00 For hourly task, the start run time is the hourly start of the task instance generation time, e.g. 2021-06-03 09:00:00
The date of a task instance starts running after all input dependencies are met, format yyyyMMdd.
The previous date of a task instance starts running after all input dependencies are met, format yyyyMMdd.

content:
--********************************************************************--
-- Author:              chengguo.liu@shopee.com
-- Created Time:        2025-11-04
-- Theme Domain：       Risk Ticket综合信息表
-- Description:         整合ticket主表和最新操作记录,提供完整的ticket数据
-- Data Granularity:    ticket_id
-- 变更历史：
--  2025-11-04 Initial version - 整合dwd_credit_reg_risk_ticket_df和dwd_credit_reg_risk_ticket_ops_df
--********************************************************************--


drop table if exists ${SCHEMA}.ads_credit_${region}_risk_finish_ticket_info_df;
create table if not exists ${SCHEMA}.ads_credit_${region}_risk_finish_ticket_info_df
(
    -- ticket主表字段
    ticket_id                          string comment 'ticket_id'
    ,workflow_flow_no                   string comment 'ticket no'
    ,app_id                             string comment 'app_id'
    ,scene_id                           string comment 'scene_id'
    ,product_code                       string comment 'product_code'
    ,ticket_category                    int comment '0 - Undefined, 1 - Liveness Check, 2 - KYC, 3 - IVR, 4 - Listing, 5 - Common 6 - Transaction 7- spr, 100-invokepolicy not real ticket'
    ,ticket_subtype                     int comment 'ticket_subtype'
    ,platform_user_id                   string comment 'platform_user_id'
    ,credit_user_id                     string comment 'credit_user_id'
    ,assignee                           string comment 'assignee from ticket table'
    ,reject_reason                      string comment 'reject_reason'
    ,ops                                string comment 'ops from ticket table'
    ,status                             int comment '0 - Unassigned, 1 - Waiting, 2 - Done'
    ,af_screen_start_time               string comment 'create_time, Approximate business time using system time'
    ,af_screen_update_time              string comment 'update_time, Approximate business time using system time'
    ,af_screen_sla_second               bigint comment 'update_time - create_time'
    ,af_screen_result                   int comment '0 - Unreviewed, 1 - Approved, 2 - Rejected'
    ,return_codes                       string comment 'reject code and reasons'
    -- ticket_ops表字段 (最新操作记录)
    ,ops_operator                       string comment 'operator from ops table'
    ,ops_content                        string comment 'operation content'
    ,ops_version                        bigint comment 'version from ops table'
    ,ops_create_time                    string comment 'ops record create time'
    ,ops_update_time                    string comment 'ops record update time'
    ,ops_notes                          string comment 'notes from ops table'
    ,ops_content_notes                  string comment 'content notes from ops table'
    ,ops_operation_type                 bigint comment 'operation type'
    ,ops_second_diff_create_update      bigint comment 'seconds between create and update in ops'
    ,ops_start_time                     string comment 'operation start time'
    ,ops_role                           string comment 'operator role'
) 
partitioned by
(
    grass_date string comment 'grass_date, partition key'
)
stored as orc
tblproperties
(
    "orc.compress" = "zstd"
)
location '${HDFS_PATH}/risk_mart/dws/ads_credit_reg_risk_finish_ticket_info_df/grass_region=${grass_region}';
msck repair table ${SCHEMA}.ads_credit_${region}_risk_finish_ticket_info_df;


-- 创建临时视图：从ops表中按ticket_id取最新操作记录
create or replace temporary view tmp_latest_ticket_ops as
select 
    ticket_id
    ,operator
    ,content
    ,version
    ,create_time
    ,update_time
    ,notes
    ,content_notes
    ,operation_type
    ,second_diff_create_update
    ,start_time
    ,role
from (
    select 
        ticket_id
        ,operator
        ,content
        ,version
        ,create_time
        ,update_time
        ,notes
        ,content_notes
        ,operation_type
        ,second_diff_create_update
        ,start_time
        ,role
        ,row_number() over (partition by ticket_id order by start_time desc) as row_num
    from risk.dwd_credit_${region}_risk_ticket_ops_df
    where grass_date = '${grass_date}'
    and role = 'maker'
    and start_time is not null
) t
where row_num = 1
;

-- 插入数据：关联ticket主表和最新操作记录
insert overwrite ${SCHEMA}.ads_credit_${region}_risk_finish_ticket_info_df partition (grass_date = '${grass_date}')
select
    -- ticket主表字段
    t.ticket_id                         as ticket_id
    ,t.workflow_flow_no                 as workflow_flow_no
    ,t.app_id                           as app_id
    ,t.scene_id                         as scene_id
    ,t.product_code                     as product_code
    ,t.ticket_category                  as ticket_category
    ,t.ticket_subtype                   as ticket_subtype
    ,t.platform_user_id                 as platform_user_id
    ,t.credit_user_id                   as credit_user_id
    ,t.assignee                         as assignee
    ,t.reject_reason                    as reject_reason
    ,t.ops                              as ops
    ,t.status                           as status
    ,t.af_screen_start_time             as af_screen_start_time
    ,t.af_screen_update_time            as af_screen_update_time
    ,t.af_screen_sla_second             as af_screen_sla_second
    ,t.af_screen_result                 as af_screen_result
    ,t.return_codes                     as return_codes
    -- ticket_ops表字段 (最新操作记录)
    ,ops.operator                       as ops_operator
    ,ops.content                        as ops_content
    ,ops.version                        as ops_version
    ,ops.create_time                    as ops_create_time
    ,ops.update_time                    as ops_update_time
    ,ops.notes                          as ops_notes
    ,ops.content_notes                  as ops_content_notes
    ,ops.operation_type                 as ops_operation_type
    ,ops.second_diff_create_update      as ops_second_diff_create_update
    ,ops.start_time                     as ops_start_time
    ,ops.role                           as ops_role
from risk.dwd_credit_${region}_risk_ticket_df t
left join tmp_latest_ticket_ops ops
    on t.ticket_id = ops.ticket_id
where t.grass_date = '${grass_date}'
  and t.status = 2
;
